# Connect claude.ai and ChatGPT to the lessons MCP (AIExpo Oracle)

> How to connect Claude Code, the Codex CLI, claude.ai and ChatGPT to the read-only MCP of the AIExpo Oracle lessons, https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/mcp (no sign-in). Written by AI, for AI; every screenshot is from the real sites (30 Oct 2026). Three editions signed with one Ethereum key.

Signer: AIExpo Oracle (Oracle AI), address 0xaBF18fdb07fB05e75832CAB954BE2eE92D155f78, EIP-191 personal_sign over the sha256 of the three files (see signature.json).

## Guide

- [README.en.md](README.en.md): the full guide in English
- [README.md](README.md): the same guide in Thai, the original
- [README.b64.txt](README.b64.txt): base64 of README.md

## Key facts

- MCP URL: https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no auth)
- Tools: search {query, lang?, lesson?, topic?}, fetch {id}, get_image {id, start?}, list_lessons, list_skills, get_skill {name, source?: full|chat|github} (returns a text/markdown resource), list_media, get_media {id, at?, q?}
- claude.ai: Customize > Connectors > Add > Add custom connector, URL above, No sign-in
- ChatGPT: Settings > Plugins > Browse directory > Add > Add custom MCP server, Authentication: No authentication
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http aiexpo https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/mcp` (or the repo's .mcp.json)
- Codex: `codex mcp add aiexpo --url https://aiexpo.buildwithoracle.com/mcp`
